visual.general_description: Five-box vertical flowchart of a hypothesized pathway from EGFR-TKI therapy to irreversible pulmonary fibrosis.
visual.detailed_description: A tall portrait flowchart on a white background with five stacked rectangular boxes joined by four hollow downward block arrows. Box 1, blue-tinted, titled Initial Insult, reads EGFR-TKI Therapy (Osimertinib/Erlotinib) followed by an arrow to Profound CD4+ T-Cell Depletion (Lymphocytopenia). Box 2, orange-tinted, titled Immunodeficiency State, reads Impaired Immune Surveillance followed by an arrow to Uncontrolled CMV Reactivation. Box 3, yellow-tinted, titled Fulminant Lung Injury, lists two arrow lines: CMV Pneumonitis and Sustained Alveolar Epithelial Injury. Box 4, green-tinted with a dashed blue border, titled Convergent Profibrotic Signaling (Hypothesized Pathways), lists four bullets: Upregulation of TGF-β, M2 Macrophage Polarization, Neutrophil Extracellular Trap (NET) Release, and Hypoxia & HIF-1α Stabilization. Box 5, pink-tinted, titled Fibrotic Outcome, lists bullets Activation of Fibroblasts / Myofibroblast Differentiation and Excessive ECM Deposition, then an arrow line to Irreversible Pulmonary Fibrosis. No patient data, numbers, names or dates are printed.
